Hi @iam4x,

Not Wordpress customfields, I am mentioning about the CustomField chrome extension, that is used to add customfields to products in shopify. This customfield extension uses shopify metafields to save values to products. For eg. refer the attached file. I need to show the customfileds as facets in algolia instantsearch UI. For eg, if I select ruby under filter, then all the products that contains ruby under other material field should come up.
